uncertain.name: INSPECTS_REFERENCE_ARTIFACT_TO_LEARN_SEMANTICS
uncertain.definition: An agent reads or examines a reference artifact (source code, example input, configuration) of the target system in order to learn its exact operational semantics before designing a solution, receiving the artifact content as an observation.
uncertain.source_description: An agent inspection/read action directed at a reference artifact of the target system.
uncertain.target_description: The observation returning the reference artifact's contents that specify the system's behavior.
